entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The Web3D Consortium is a non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: ISO/IEC JTC 1
entities.note: ISO/IEC JTC 1 is a joint technical committee of the International Organization for Standardization and the International Electrotechnical Commission.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) is the main international standards organization for the World Wide Web.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: The Khronos Group is an open consortium that creates advanced, royalty-free interoperability standards for 3D graphics.

entities.name: X3D Working Group
entities.note: The X3D Working Group is responsible for the technical development of the Extensible 3D specifications.

entities.name: H-Anim Working Group
entities.note: The H-Anim Working Group develops standards for human animation in Web3D environments.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: The Medical Working Group focuses on the use of X3D for medical visualization and health informatics.

entities.name: VRML97
entities.note: VRML97 is the predecessor to X3D, standardized as ISO/IEC 14772.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: Extensible 3D (X3D) is a royalty-free open standards file format and run-time architecture to represent and communicate 3D scenes.

entities.name: X3D 3.0
entities.note: X3D 3.0 is the initial version of the X3D standard that transitioned VRML to an XML-based architecture.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: X3D 3.3 introduced new nodes and profiles, including the Medical profile.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: X3D 4.0 is a major update that closely integrates X3D with HTML5 and modern web technologies.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 14772
entities.note: ISO/IEC 14772 is the formal ISO specification for the Virtual Reality Modeling Language (VRML97).

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19775
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19775 defines the abstract architecture and base components of X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19775-1
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19775-1 specifies the X3D architecture and base components.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19775-2
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19775-2 specifies the Scene Access Interface (SAI) for X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19776 defines the various data encodings for X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-1
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19776-1 specifies the XML encoding of X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-2
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19776-2 specifies the ClassicVRML encoding of X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-3
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19776-3 specifies the Compressed Binary encoding of X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19777 defines the programming language bindings for the X3D Scene Access Interface.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-1
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19777-1 specifies the ECMAScript (JavaScript) binding for X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-2
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19777-2 specifies the Java binding for X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-3
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19777-3 specifies the C language binding for X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-4
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19777-4 specifies the C++ language binding for X3D.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-5
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19777-5 specifies the C# language binding for X3D.

entities.name: H-Anim
entities.note: Humanoid Animation (H-Anim) is a standard for representing humanoids in 3D graphics.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19774
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19774 is the formal ISO specification for Humanoid Animation (H-Anim).

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19774-1
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19774-1 specifies the architecture for H-Anim humanoids.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19774-2
entities.note: ISO/IEC 19774-2 specifies the motion data animation format for H-Anim.

entities.name: X3D JSON Encoding
entities.note: The X3D JSON encoding allows X3D scenes to be represented using JavaScript Object Notation.

entities.name: X3D Python Binding
entities.note: The X3D Python binding (x3d.py) provides a Pythonic interface to generate and manipulate X3D scenes.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: glTF is a royalty-free specification for the efficient transmission and loading of 3D scenes and models.

entities.name: HTML5
entities.note: HTML5 is the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: Don Brutzman is a key contributor to the Web3D Consortium and co-author of X3D specifications.

entities.name: Dick Puk
entities.note: Dick Puk is a long-time contributor to X3D and VRML standards, focusing on formal specification editing.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: Nicholas Polys is a Web3D Consortium leader who has significantly contributed to the Medical Working Group and X3D 4.0.
